atoms.text: Jennifer has made some pictures using only quadrilaterals. Can you look through them and identify all the different types?

instruction.text: Select all the rectangles in the picture.
Select all the kites in the picture.
Select all the trapeziums in the picture.
Fill in the gaps to answer the question. Once a shape has been counted, it can’t be counted again.
